```mermaid
flowchart TD

    V -->|Keep negotiating| J
    V -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| W{Named human signer?}
    W -->|No| X[Gate stays closed]
    W -->|Yes| Y{Execution tools available?}
    Y -->|No| X
    Y -->|Yes| AA["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    AA --> AB{Result}
    AB -->|Success| AC[Done]
    AB -->|Floor failure| AD["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    AD --> J
```
